meta.name: cold-outbound-sequencer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build a B2B cold-outbound sequence", "design reply-triage branching", "plan a domain warmup / sending throttle", or "make my outbound CAN-SPAM / opt-in compliant"; produces a multi-step outbound sequence with reply-triage branches (positive / objection / referral / not-now / opt-out), a warmup + send-throttle ramp schedule, jurisdiction opt-in/CAN-SPAM guardrails (guidance, not legal advice), and a SEND S-dimension read. Not for B2C lifecycle flows — use email-sequence-designer; not for the consent record — use consent-registry; not for computing EQS — use email-quality-auditor. B2B冷启动外联序列/回复分流/域名预热

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计B2B冷启动外联序列，自动分流回复并合规预热
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做B2B冷启动邮件外联，需要自动处理回复并确保合规
copy.tagline_en: Design B2B cold-outbound sequences with reply triage and compliant warmup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are running B2B cold email outreach and need automated reply handling and compliance

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计一套 B2B 冷启动外联流程，包括多步骤序列、回复分流、域名预热和发送限速，以及 CAN-SPAM 合规指引。它还会读取发件人信誉维度并给出评分。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建 B2B 冷启动外联序列”、“设计回复分流分支”、“规划域名预热/发送限速”或“让外联符合 CAN-SPAM/opt-in 合规”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个针对 SaaS 创始人的 5 步冷启动外联序列。
say.note: Claude 会输出序列步骤、时间、退出规则等。

say.text: 规划 3 个新邮箱的预热计划和每日发送上限。
say.note: Claude 会给出每周每邮箱的发送量阶梯。

say.text: 为我的外联设计回复分流：积极、异议、推荐、暂缓、退订。
say.note: Claude 会生成分支路由表。

howto.what_en: Claude designs a B2B cold-outbound program: multi-step sequence with reply-triage branching, domain/mailbox warmup ramp and per-mailbox send throttle, CAN-SPAM/opt-in jurisdiction guardrails, and a SEND S-dimension read.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build a B2B cold-outbound sequence", "design reply-triage branching", "plan a domain warmup / sending throttle", or "make my outbound CAN-SPAM / opt-in compliant".

say_en.text: Design a 5-step cold-outbound sequence for SaaS founders.
say_en.note: Claude outputs steps, timing, exit rules.

say_en.text: Plan a warmup ramp and daily send cap for 3 new mailboxes.
say_en.note: Claude gives weekly per-mailbox volume ramp.

say_en.text: Design reply-triage branching: positive, objection, referral, not-now, opt-out.
say_en.note: Claude generates a branch routing table.
